visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Centre With Flexbox
visualizerParams.description: Type a stage that centres its child both ways. With display flex, justify-content centres along the row and align-items centres across it.

checks.label: The stage is a flex container
The dot is centred sideways
checks.expr: (() => { var s = el('.stage').getBoundingClientRect(), d = el('.dot').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((s.left + s.width / 2) - (d.left + d.width / 2)) < 1; })()

checks.label: The dot is centred up and down
checks.expr: (() => { var s = el('.stage').getBoundingClientRect(), d = el('.dot').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((s.top + s.height / 2) - (d.top + d.height / 2)) < 1; })()
